interviewer.name: log_answer
interviewer.description: Log the expert's answer to the question you just asked, in their words. Call it as soon as they have answered.

stepRef.description: The stepRef or slot id from the [ASK] or [DEBRIEF] tag

reason.description: The expert's answer, in their words, not reworded

guardrail.description: Any limit, exception or stop-and-ask the expert mentioned, or empty

kind.description: why, counterfactual, limit, stop, who or debrief

interviewer.name: mark_off_record
interviewer.description: Strike the last part of the conversation from the record because the expert said off the record, scratch that or do not keep that. The result starts with 'struck' when it worked.

seconds.description: How many seconds back to strike; omit to strike the current question window

interviewer.name: confirm_teachback
interviewer.description: Record whether the expert confirmed the teach-back or corrected it.

confirmed.description: true if the expert said yes, that is how it works

corrections.description: The expert's correction verbatim when confirmed is false

interviewer.name: end_task
interviewer.description: The expert said they are done with the task or asked to stop.

tutor.name: show_replay
tutor.description: Optional. Show the expert's screen moment for the step. The app also shows it by itself.

rule.description: The rule title, if no stepId was given

tutor.name: record_prediction
tutor.description: Record whether the new hire predicted the expert's decision correctly.

tutor.name: record_mastery
tutor.description: Record a mastery outcome for a rule, for example that the learner recognised who to ask.

tutor.name: flag_for_expert
tutor.description: Flag a case the expert never showed, so the Work Map asks the expert about it next time.

context.description: What is on screen, in one line

tutor.name: end_session
tutor.description: The new hire asked to stop.
